fact: The ITU repository lists the Gabon Digital Development Strategy (SGDN) / 'Gabon-Digital' as the country's strategy and says the countries it lists have adopted one; no adopting act is named, so this is dated by the repository's 2025 publication year.
The repository gives the time frame of the Gabon Digital Development Strategy (SGDN) / 'Gabon-Digital' as 2020 - 2025.
The repository names ANINF as lead/owner of the Gabon Digital Development Strategy (SGDN) / 'Gabon-Digital'.

A steering committee of the Plan national stratégique Gabon digital 2025 (PNS-GD2025), meeting by videoconference with the African Development Bank, ANINF, the Prime Minister's office, the budget ministry and the government's general secretariat, is reported; the report does not describe the plan's scope. Date is the article's published date.

The article states the Gabon digital 2025 strategic plan is financed by the African Development Bank under project CAB Gabon through the Korea-Africa cooperation trust fund. Date is the article's published date.

Gabonreview reports that at a meeting with state IT directors on 3 April 2026 the digital economy minister presented the main orientations of the national digitalisation strategy, built on five axes (regulatory framework, infrastructure, public services, local skills, data governance), and that sector master plans are still to be drawn up; it states no adoption or text.

On 3 April 2026 the digital economy minister presented the five-axis national digitalisation strategy to state IT directors and announced a permanent consultation framework with them and progressive sector master plans.
